optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction

professionalSummary.text: Candidate has three years of experience as a Site Project Coordinator on utility-scale solar farm construction sites.
professionalSummary.witness: Site project coordinator on two utility-scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the construction schedule by tracking subcontractor progress on live construction sites.
experienceHighlights.witness: Site project coordinator on two utility-scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Records the daily site diary and permit-to-work register under site procedures, with quarterly audits by the site health and safety adviser.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recorded the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures, with both audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser without findings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares weekly progress reports for the developer's site representative and maintains records of comments.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative, with the reports and the representative's comments filed in the site folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracks material deliveries against the schedule and documents resolution of delivery queries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Tracked the material deliveries against the schedule in the delivery log, recording which delivery queries I resolved with the suppliers and which needed the site project manager's site instruction.

experienceHighlights.text: Documents hand-over conditions at construction milestones and has these notes countersigned by the site project manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the hand-over condition notes at the mechanical completion and grid connection milestones on both sites, countersigned by the site project manager.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provides work samples including one month's schedule updates, one week's site diary and permit-to-work register pages, one weekly progress report, and one milestone hand-over note.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one month's schedule updates, one week's site diary and permit-to-work register pages, one weekly progress report and one milestone hand-over note, with the site folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Maintains accurate and up-to-date records of site activities, including daily diaries, permit-to-work registers, and progress reports.
skills.witness: Recorded the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures, with both audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser without findings. Prepared the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative, with the reports and the representative's comments filed in the site folder.
